representation_sensitivity.interpretation: The residual subspace is not invariant at the level of each individual axis, but most of the 5D space remains moderately aligned under reasonable unit-definition changes. Representation dependence is real and must be retained as uncertainty.

initial_variable_eligibility.audit: This comparison mixes estimator scale with changing paragraph eligibility and is not accepted as the primary test.

window_sensitivity.interpretation: The strongest 2D residual subspace is stable across 15-40 token windows on the same paragraph set. The third residual direction is scale-sensitive at longer windows. H57-2 is supported only for the leading low-dimensional residual, not for every axis.

richer_structural_prediction.cv: 5-fold grouped by physical leaf; training-fold-only context; Ridge alpha fixed at 10
richer_structural_prediction.interpretation: Adding richer local physical context does not explain away the residual and in this conservative implementation does not improve held-out prediction. This supports H57-3 relative to these predictors, while also warning that page-context gains from Phase56 are model/preprocessing-sensitive.

gate_status.H57_1: PARTIAL SUPPORT — leading residual space survives representation changes but rotates nontrivially
gate_status.H57_2: SUPPORTED FOR TOP-2 / PARTIAL OVERALL — top-2 stable across W15-40; PC3 is scale-sensitive
gate_status.H57_3: SUPPORTED RELATIVE TO TESTED CONTEXT MODELS — richer leakage-safe local context does not collapse residual
gate_status.H57_4: pending explicit leakage re-audit under all perturbations

next: Complete 57D broad-label leakage and resampling stability on the representation/scale consensus subspace. Do not expose residual to semantic tests until that gate is passed.
